Statement-level and implication-level searches found no source giving a rank-only atom bound for its bounded correlation representation. value.rationale: The atom count is a natural complexity parameter of the focal simple-function representation. The rank-sensitive bound can be dramatically smaller than ambient Caratheodory bounds when many Bessel vectors lie in a low-dimensional span, and the proof identifies the structural reason for that compression. It is not merely a relabeling or a numerical recomputation.
